component.name: DiagnosticsScreen
component.script:
sub init_x() m.top.findNode("header").color = accentColor() di = CreateObject("roDeviceInfo") info = [] info.Push("App: Hortêncioflix v" + appVersion()) info.Push("Aparelho: " + di.GetModelDisplayName() + " (" + di.GetModel() + ")") v = di.GetOSVersion() if v <> invalid then info.Push("Roku OS: " + strOr(v.major) + "." + strOr(v.minor) + " build " + strOr(v.build)) ip = "" addrs = di.GetIPAddrs() for each k in addrs if ip = "" then ip = addrs[k] + " (" + k + ")" end for info.Push("Rede: " + di.GetConnectionType() + " · IP " + ip) dm = di.GetDisplayMode() info.Push("Ecrã: " + dm + " · 4K: " + boolText(di.CanDecodeVideo({ Codec: "hevc", Profile: "main10" }).result) + " · Dolby Vision: " + boolText(di.CanDecodeVideo({ Codec: "dvhe" }).result) + " · AV1: " + boolText(di.CanDecodeVideo({ Codec: "av1" }).result)) reg = registryUsage() info.Push("Armazenamento de definições: " + Int(reg / 1024).ToStr() + "," + Int((reg mod 1024) / 103).ToStr() + " KB de 16 KB") info.Push("Perfil: " + strOr(currentProfile().n) + " · Add-ons: " + getAddons().Count().ToStr() + " · Biblioteca Stremio: " + libAll().Count().ToStr() + " itens") tb = "não" if cfgRead("torboxKey", "") <> "" then tb = "sim" tr = "não" if cfgRead("traktToken", "") <> "" then tr = "sim" info.Push("Conta Stremio: " + boolText(stremioLinked()) + " · TorBox: " + tb + " · Trakt: " + tr) m.top.findNode("info").text = info.Join(Chr(10)) logs = [] if m.global.hasField("logs") and m.global.logs <> invalid then logs = m.global.logs if logs.Count() = 0 then logs = ["(sem erros registados nesta sessão)"] m.top.findNode("logs").content = labelContent(logs) m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onFocusedChild") end sub sub init() try init_x() catch e reportCrash("DiagnosticsScreen.init", e) end try end sub
function boolText(b as dynamic) as string if b = true then return "sim" return "não" end function
sub onFocusedChild_x() if m.top.hasFocus() then m.top.findNode("logs").setFocus(true) end sub sub onFocusedChild() try onFocusedChild_x() catch e reportCrash("DiagnosticsScreen.onFocusedChild", e) end try end sub
